narratives.UserStory: As a through-merge parent on a Tier-1 host, I want undeclared forge-poll and path-only TEMP babysit shells refused before execution so that only Approach 1 child-bound pr:watch is the lawful pre-CLEAN wait.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Wire production PreToolUse/deft-hook refuse-before-execution on SHELL_TOOL_NAMES after payload unwrap for closed Observed undeclared-babysit class including path-only TEMP.
2. Keep remediation on formatApproach1CheapestAdmissionCard; do not widen evaluateBoundedPrWatchDeny.
3. Add regressions for every mandatory corpus form asserting executor not reached.
4. CHANGELOG Unreleased for #5732.
